_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Preparing: make an invoice or order from a quote or order

annotations.title: Propose: Make an invoice or order from a quote or order

description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use when the person asks for this in a system whose AI agent may change records: A new invoice or order with the lines of a quote, or an invoice from an order, linked to it and not sent; nothing is made when one was made from it already. Give one item per record, at most 25. Nothing is written yet: the answer shows, per record, what it holds now and would hold after, plus a proposal id. Show it to the person, say so first when something would be sent to the people in their system, ask whether to go ahead, and only then call apply_proposal; when needsApproval is true, share the approve link instead. Not for reading (use search_records or get_record).

items.description: One object per record, at most 25.

id.description: The id of the quote or order in the system.

into.description: What to make: an invoice, or an order from a quote. An invoice when left out.

item_kind.description: For an order, the kind order instead of a type.

type.description: The type of the record: a quote.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agent_options, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.
